title: Collatz: high rational-cycle constructions and forced inverse routes
body:
## New checkpoint: high-variance closing attacks

**Full Collatz remains OPEN.** Three parallel attacks pursued the actual closing mechanisms: complete-denominator cycle exclusion, unbounded cheap source surgery, and regularity of the canonical inverse law. No universal convergence theorem was obtained. This checkpoint gives an all-modulus primitive rational-cycle construction, a stronger infinite height subsequence, and an all-horizons obstruction to a proposed ordinary source-routing step.

**Published head:** [aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/commit/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45)

## 1. Every fixed congruence precision admits high primitive rational controls

For a chronological shortcut word of length L and weight P, write

```text
C(w) = sum_i 2^(d_i) 3^(P-1-i)
D(w) = 2^L - 3^P.
```

The new constructive written theorem applies to every M>=1 coprime to six, every height H>=0, and every prime ell>=5 not dividing M. It produces a primitive positive rational Collatz cycle whose every state exceeds H and whose complete word satisfies

```text
D > 0,   4L < 7P,
M divides D and C,
ell divides D, but ell does not divide C.
```

Thus the specified finite congruence tests pass at the correct distinguished evaluation, while the displayed extra prime certifies nonintegrality. No denominator factor is discarded through a norm.

**Precision matters:** this says that the prescribed prime powers in M divide both C and D. It does not assert that the full valuation of every prime dividing M cancels when D has a higher valuation. Adaptive prime selection and precision depending on the complete word remain available.

### Infinite quadratic-height strengthening

For fixed M and ell, put t=lcm(phi(M),ell-1), with phi(1)=1. Infinitely many of the constructed primitive rational cycles satisfy

```text
minimum cycle state > L^2 / (3888 M^2 t^2).
```

Their minimum/period ratio is unbounded while the same modulus is retained. The finite amplification hypothesis is the exact integer inequality

```text
2^(B*a0) < 2*3^(B*q),
```

which implies every state is greater than B*a0/216. Upper convergents to log_2(3) give infinitely many choices with B=q; the note reconstructs the continued-fraction error formula.

### How the construction works

A balanced word U is rotated to begin 10101. A single adjacent swap creates V beginning 11001 and changes the **complete** carry by exactly

```text
C(U)-C(V) = 2*3^(p-2).
```

Euler/Fermat parameters make both block multipliers one modulo M and ell. One of k=1,2 retains a nonzero carry at ell. The full word U^(kM)V^M pays M and fails ell. Its unique longest gap between 00 markers proves primitivity. Cyclic discrepancy below three and absence of 000 yield a positive backward-series lower bound at every state.

[Complete construction, height proof and limits](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45/research/high-variance-20261123/CYCLE_IDEAL.md) · [Scoped reconstruction review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45/reports/2026-11-23-high-variance/CYCLE_REVIEW.md)

This is a **proposed written theorem with completed internal reconstruction reviews**. The base construction was independently reconstructed; the reviewer who suggested the amplification discloses that contribution. The full existence, primitivity, rational realization and infinite height subsequence are not claimed Lean-formalized.

## 2. An exact all-depth ordinary routing obstruction

For every B>=0, define

```text
q_B = 2*3^(B+2)-1
x_i = 2^(i+1)*3^(B+2-i)-1,   0<=i<=B.
```

Every positive odd unit inverse path from q_B of length at most B, with exponents restricted to1,2,3,4, is forced to follow these vertices with exponent one throughout. Each vertex is8 mod9 and cannot be7 mod729. The Lean module also constructs every prefix, including one of depth B.

This refutes the proposed root-independent bounded-depth routing premise. The initial integer depends on B. It is not one all-time avoiding ordinary integer and does not rule out logarithmic root-dependent routing, a restricted certified family, or a different target-aware source surgery.

The source lane tried to exploit unlimited smaller-letter credit in the multiset rank and to remove the earlier source-ceiling family's large-suffix-gap qualification. No unbounded legal replacement family satisfying the original endpoint and target requirements was constructed.

[Attempt and theorem](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45/research/high-variance-20261123/SOURCE_SURGERY.md) · [Complete Lean route proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45/research/high-variance-20261123/ForcedRoute.lean) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45/reports/2026-11-23-high-variance/SOURCE_ROUTE_REVIEW.md)

## 3. The canonical escape attack and a precise entropy control

The existing exact harmonic inverse flow has summable sibling leakage along a hypothetical escaping ray. The current modular-routing estimates retain a depth-dependent loss at the specified ordinary spike. The attempted opposite entropy estimate and polynomial-phase approximation of the actual canonical escape label were not proved.

A second proposed shortcut inferred shift regularity from finite descent and exact doubling invariance. The new standalone control constructs exactly doubling-invariant sequences with **fair Bernoulli consecutive-word frequencies**. Independent fair labels on odd parts, an O_L(1/N) variance estimate, and square-subsequence Borel--Cantelli prove the claim. These sequences are not asserted to obey the odd Collatz equation or canonical harmonic identities.

[Attempt and complete control](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45/research/high-variance-20261123/ESCAPE_RIGIDITY.md) · [Review and contribution boundaries](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45/reports/2026-11-23-high-variance/SEMANTIC_REVIEW.md)

## 4. Fresh formalization and actual verification

**24 new public Lean statements, including supporting lemmas, across two modules:**

| Module | Checked scope |
|---|---|
| CycleWordAlgebra,12 | Chronological complete carries; arbitrary-context adjacent swap; repeated/mixed-block quotient identities; complete denominator payment; two-choice nonzero carry. |
| ForcedRoute,12 | Exact unit-output edge classification, actual state formulas, existence of each prefix, uniqueness of every supplied route, and the all-B avoidance theorem. |

- Both modules and the exhaustive generated audit compiled from fresh project outputs, with warnings treated as errors.
- Lean4.34.1/compiler `5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52`; tracked-clean Mathlib `d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612`.
- Every theorem's axiom closure uses only a subset of propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. No admission or custom Collatz/analytic axiom.
- The complete four-family arithmetic checker passed normally and under Python-O on the same unchanged final bytes. Four damaged controls were rejected in each mode.
- Every rational parity step and each finite ordinary witness step was replayed. An additional exact case exercised k=2. A reviewer separately checked four smaller controls using reduced Fraction arithmetic at every rotation.
- The default five-command repository gate passed on the clean scientific checkpoint and again on the **actual published head**, with **439 tracked files** and unchanged checkout identity.
- All23 source/report bindings and both new compiled source hashes match the published checkout. All31 previously tracked Lean source files remain byte-identical to the parent.
- Existing Mathlib dependency objects were reused. This is not a Mathlib source rebuild or a replay of the previous PR182 proof packet. Repository integrity is separate from proof verification.

[Lean receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45/reports/2026-11-23-high-variance/LEAN_RECEIPT.json) · [All24 axiom reports](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45/reports/2026-11-23-high-variance/AXIOM_AUDIT.json) · [Exact execution receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45/reports/2026-11-23-high-variance/EXACT_RECEIPT.json) · [Complete controls](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45/reports/2026-11-23-high-variance/CYCLE_CONTROLS.json) · [Source binding](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45/reports/2026-11-23-high-variance/SOURCE_BINDING.json)

## Preserved earlier work and remaining closing step

The earlier polynomial-phase rigidity, canonical Green identities and escape label, dyadic-band returns, coefficient alternatives, and complete-tail source-ceiling results remain intact with their original evidence. The preceding PR description is preserved in [PR182_BEFORE.json](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45/reports/2026-11-23-high-variance/PR182_BEFORE.json).

The current source refresh includes advanced PR175/176/177/178/180/185 heads and thirty recently updated open-PR metadata records. It is targeted source reconciliation, not a new proof audit of all branches. [Exact ledger](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45/research/high-variance-20261123/SOURCES.json).

The unresolved goal is still an arithmetic mechanism forcing actual original-target descent, eliminating the actual escaping source, or selecting a failing prime power for every nontrivial complete integer cycle word. The new rational construction does not supply integer cycles, and the routing control does not supply escape. The draft PR remains exploratory.
